title: County Employment and Wages in Arizona: Fourth Quarter 2025
summary: BLS reports that Maricopa County had 2,318,500 covered jobs in December 2025, down 0.1 percent from a year earlier, while its fourth-quarter average weekly wage was $1,512, up 2.3 percent.
key_findings: Maricopa County's December 2025 covered employment was 2,318,500, a 0.1 percent year-over-year decline.
The county's fourth-quarter 2025 average weekly wage was $1,512, 2.3 percent above the prior-year quarter.
QCEW covers more than 95 percent of U.S. jobs but remains a lagged administrative dataset with disclosure and industry-detail limits.
why_it_matters: The release adds a current county-level employment and wage baseline to the Phoenix industrial-conversion dossier, complementing metropolitan occupation estimates.
ftfn_relevance: Adds measured Maricopa employment and wage context to Human Futures.
Supports later semiconductor, construction, utility, and technical-services industry queries.
Separates broad labor-market conditions from employer-specific workforce sufficiency.
evidence_limits: County totals do not isolate semiconductor employers, occupations, vacancies, or skills.
The data do not prove workforce availability, training fit, retention, productivity, or project readiness.
Quarterly releases are lagged and detailed values can be suppressed or revised.
